title: Companion
subtitle: A calm place to understand what happened, what you feel, and what tends to happen next.
placeholderWithMic: Write a few words or use the mic. You can edit before sending.
placeholder: Write a few words. You can edit before sending.
emptyMemory: I’ll learn your patterns as you check in and reflect.
pauseBody: Paste the message first. Companion will help check tone, patterns, and a calmer version.

promptMessages.overwhelmed: I feel overwhelmed. Help me understand what set this off and what my body is asking for.
promptMessages.rejected: I feel rejected. Help me separate what happened from what my mind says it means.
promptMessages.react: I want to text or react impulsively. Help me name what happened, what I feel, and what I usually do next.
promptMessages.calm: Help me calm down first, then help me name what happened right before this got intense.

memoryLabels.recentEmotionGreeting: I remember {{emotion}} came up recently. Does today feel connected to that, or is this a different feeling?

greetingFallback: Hi. What feels most important to talk through?
aiLanguageInstruction: Language preference: respond in neutral Latin American Spanish by default. Preserve the user's text unchanged. Do not translate prior conversation history automatically. Continue in Spanish even if internal app context is English, unless the user explicitly asks for another language. Keep all crisis and safety behavior unchanged.

chat.saveInsightHint: Save this conversation insight so it appears in Insights later.
chat.emptySubtitle: I can use your recent check-ins, triggers, and goals to help you slow down, reflect, or pause before reacting.
chat.safetyText: If you may hurt yourself or someone else, contact local emergency services or a crisis line now.
chat.privateHelper: Everything here is private and supportive

quickActionMessages.Slow this down: I need to slow this down. Can we take it one small step at a time?
quickActionMessages.Reflection: I want to reflect on what I’m feeling right now. Can you help me explore this?
quickActionMessages.What pattern do you see?: Based on what you know about me, what patterns do you notice here?
quickActionMessages.Help me respond securely: Help me craft a response that comes from security, not reactivity.

contextSuggestions.factsPrompt: Help me start with the facts of what happened.
contextSuggestions.emotionPrompt: Help me name the strongest emotion right now.
contextSuggestions.urgeLabel: What do I want to do?
contextSuggestions.urgePrompt: Help me name what I feel pulled to do next.
contextSuggestions.bodyFirstPrompt: Help me calm my body before I decide what to say or do.
contextSuggestions.beforeAngerPrompt: Help me identify what happened right before the anger.
contextSuggestions.waitPrompt: Help me name the concrete thing I noticed before the feeling got stronger.
contextSuggestions.emptyTypePrompt: Help me tell whether this feels like numb, lonely, disconnected, bored, or hopeless.
contextSuggestions.whenStartedPrompt: Help me identify when this feeling started.
contextSuggestions.rewritePrompt: Help me rewrite what I want to say in a calmer, clearer way.
contextSuggestions.patternPrompt: Help me name what usually happens when this starts.
